sentences.text: The domestic dog -LRB- Canis lupus familiaris or Canis familiaris -RRB- is a member of genus Canis -LRB- canines -RRB- that forms part of the wolf-like canids , and is the most widely abundant carnivore .	Canis	Canis	wolf-like canids	Evolution of the wolf#Wolf-like canids	carnivore	carnivore
The dog and the extant gray wolf are sister taxa , with modern wolves not closely related to the wolves that were first domesticated .	gray wolf	gray wolf	taxa	taxa	domesticated	domestication

The dog was the first domesticated species and has been selectively bred over millennia for various behaviors , sensory capabilities , and physical attributes .	domesticated	domestication	selectively bred	selective breeding

Their long association with humans has led dogs to be uniquely attuned to human behavior and they are able to thrive on a starch-rich diet that would be inadequate for other canid species .	long association with humans	Human–canine bond	starch	starch
Dogs vary widely in shape , size and colours .

Dogs perform many roles for people , such as hunting , herding , pulling loads , protection , assisting police and military , companionship and , more recently , aiding handicapped individuals .	hunting	hunting dog	herding	herding dog	pulling loads	sled dog	protection	guard dog	assisting police	police dog	military	Dogs in warfare	companionship	pet	aiding handicapped individuals	service dog
This influence on human society has given them the sobriquet `` man 's best friend '' .	sobriquet	sobriquet
